title: Sales Performance Manager - Fort Myers
description:
Description

Who we are:

TRANZACT is a leading direct-to-consumer insurance services business, specializing in the distribution of Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement and Life & Supplemental insurance policies. Our focus is on leveraging our highly skilled team of over 3,000 professionals to deliver innovative solutions for our insurance carrier partners and provide consumers with a best-in-class experience.

We work with some of America’s largest insurance brands to attract, educate and connect with consumers. Our diverse team of analysts, writers, engineers, designers, business leaders, data scientists and sales professionals all work together to create thoughtful, data-driven and effective marketing, technology, sales and servicing strategies. These efforts have resulted in TRANZACT earning recognition and winning awards from some of the biggest names in the industry.

When you become part of TRANZACT, you join a team of passionate people who push for excellence, follow through on commitments, and love to succeed together. Our culture rests on a simple principle – “Be Real” – that means being genuine, keeping your word, and having the courage to make tough decisions. Our “Be Real” values resonate and are meaningful to us. We are entrepreneurial, fast paced and empower our people. We know how to make things happen and know that our people are always the source of our success.

We are currently seeking a highly motivated and skilled professional to join our Sales Center team as a Sales Performance Manager.

How the Position Works

The Sales Performance Manager is responsible for driving performance, development, and quality outcomes across a team of sales agents. This leader plays a critical role in coaching for continuous improvement, ensuring compliance with quality standards, and creating a high-performance culture focused on customer satisfaction and productivity.

Key Responsibilities include:

  • Directly manage and support a team of Member Care Representatives to deliver outstanding customer service and meet performance goals.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop team members through regular feedback, one-on-ones, performance reviews, and tailored development plans.
  • Monitor team performance, ensuring adherence to KPIs such as call quality, productivity, customer satisfaction (CSAT), and compliance metrics.
  • Identify training needs and partner with internal teams to deliver targeted training programs.
  • Drive a performance-driven culture by setting clear goals, recognizing achievements, and addressing performance concerns proactively.
  • Participate in the hiring, onboarding, and continuous development of new team members.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Quality Assurance, Training, and Workforce Management to optimize team performance.
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on team metrics, identifying trends and recommending actions to improve results.
  • Lead performance improvement plans (PIPs) when necessary and maintain accurate performance documentation.
  • Support change management initiatives and communicate updates clearly to ensure team alignment.
  • Take ownership of special projects or initiatives assigned.
  • This position requires working in an office five days per week and on the weekends as needed, especially during Annual Enrollment Period (AEP).

Qualifications

What you need to be successful:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • 2+ years of call center leadership experience required.
  • 1+ years of experience in a direct supervisory role
  • Prior experience coaching and managing performance of customer service or sales teams.
  • Experience launching or scaling new teams, programs, or initiatives is a strong plus.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to lead, coach, and influence others effectively.
  • Self-motivated with a proven ability to drive performance while maintaining high standards of quality and service.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong analytical and conflict resolution skills.
  • Adept at managing through change in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • Understanding life insurance, Medicare and Medicaid regulations and healthcare industry best practices a plus

TRANZACT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We help the world run better
At SAP, we enable you to bring out your best. Our company culture is focused on collaboration and a shared passion to help the world run better. How? PURPOSE AND OBJECTIVES
The Office of Ethics and Compliance (OEC) is a part of the Office of the CEO Board area, and reports to both the CEO and the Audit Committee of the Supervisory Board. Our mission is to advance SAP’s business goals by promoting a culture of integrity, and by mitigating a defined set of legal risks in the area of corruption, bribery and substantial fraud. The OEC is responsible for various SAP compliance initiatives, including oversight and support of the SAP Code of Ethics and Business Conduct, employee compliance training and communications, and the global governance framework. We also monitor and enforce compliance with relevant company policies and procedures. Our focus includes compliance with the FCPA (Foreign Corrupt Practices Act), UK Bribery Act, and other global anti-corruption and bribery laws
EXPECTATIONS AND TASKS
Responsibilities
The successful candidate will be expected to take ownership in managing a dynamic landscape, with support and guidance from the Brazil and Global OEC Leadership. His/her key responsibilities will be:

  • Administer policies on compliance topics including avoidance of bribery, and corruption, handling confidentiality and conflicts of interest, doing business with government customers, fraud in the contracting process, general fraud, etc.
  • Directly support the legal compliance aspects of managing third party relationships.
  • Conduct Executive Compliance Committees with the Senior Leadership of the country
  • Review and analyze donation, sponsorship, membership requests.
  • Proper administration of SAP Code of Ethics and Business Conduct and ensuring single point of contact for issues relating to the Code.
  • Interact with employees to clarify questions regarding SAP Policies.
  • Manage adoption and localization of global projects
  • Monitor changes to legal and regulatory climate/guidelines applicable to the company and proactively develop solutions
  • Effectively channel inquiries and complaints; provide clarification & advice; assist in effective response mechanism.
  • Monitor compliance trends globally, including compliance initiatives, industry compliance failures and other internal and external Compliance trends to provide insight for leadership knowledge forums, newsletters, and employee groups
  • Track and report compliance issues to OEC management on a periodic basis
  • Support OEC investigations and Third Party Audits and orchestrate appropriate consequence management for employees and third parties.
The position works on company policies and procedural change. It liaises with multiple areas to align compliance policies.
The position reports to the Regional Compliance Officer LAC, and enjoys excellent exposure within the business
Education And Qualification / Skills And Competencies
  • Full proficiency with English and Portuguese is required, Spanish is desired
  • Accredited lawyer or certified compliance professional is preferred
  • Solid experience in compliance
  • Solid experience in-house in compliance
  • Hands-on with extreme attention to detail and written documentation
  • Ability to do in-depth research and to interpret written guidelines and documents
  • Proactive, dynamic, project management skills and result-driven individual
  • Strong grasp of code of conduct, business ethics policies and current compliance trends
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex issues and recommend solutions
  • Experience in the areas of detection and prevention of fraud or corruption
  • Demonstrated ability to work with international, virtual teams with sensitivity to cultural differences
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills required
  • Ability and experience to interact with senior management is essential
  • Experience with delivering live or virtual training is preferred
  • Comfortable in MS Office tools and IT business environment
  • Previous experience in the IT industry is preferred
  • Experience designing and documenting business processes and analyzing related gaps
Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.
We win with inclusion
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better and more equitable world.

title: Regional Sales Manager LAM
description:
An Amazing Career Opportunity for a Regional Sales Manager, Latin America!!

Location: Remote, Brazil (Preferably Sao Paolo)

Job ID: 38490

HID is seeking a driven and experienced Regional Sales Manager (RSM) to lead the promotion and sales of Omnikey Desktop and Embedded readers across the LAM region. As a dedicated RSM for this region, you will play a critical role in establishing HID’s presence in the region, building a foundation for growth by developing new channels, securing key partnerships, and driving the adoption of Omnikey solutions in all key verticals such as Healthcare, Enterprise, Banking, Secure Printing, and EV Charging.

The RSM will take full ownership of channel development, go-to-market (GTM) strategy, market penetration, and the growth of HID's EAT RFID solutions, working closely with internal teams and external partners to ensure that the Omnikey product line achieves maximum visibility and success in the LAM market.

The ideal candidate will develop and manage the regional sales strategy, build and maintain relationships with distributors and resellers, and ensure a structured sales process to maximize revenue. A deep understanding of the Latin American market, business culture, and distribution channels is essential. The role requires bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish (Portuguese is a plus).

Who are we?

HID powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely.

At the Biometric Identity Technologies Business Area, within HID, we aim to create a safer world with biometric solutions that enhance everyday life, ensuring trust and reliability in every interaction. As a trusted biometric leader, we seamlessly and ethically protect people, places, and things, where we create a secure and equitable environment where everyone’s data is protected and their privacy respected.

Driven by years of innovation, we offer a broad range of biometric identity technologies for transactions requiring irrefutable proof of identity, such as customer onboarding, fraud prevention, loss prevention, seamless travel, forensic investigation, background checks, border security, and government benefit issuance. We provide peace of mind to a great array of organizations and industries who know that they are getting the highest level of safety and security through trusted identity.

Are you ready to make a difference? Join us and help shape the future of security.

As our Regional Sales Manager, you’ll support HID’s success by:

  • Channel and Partner Management: Establishing, managing, and maintaining a robust channel network by identifying, onboarding, and training new distributors, resellers, and system integrators. Build strong relationships with channel partners to maximize product availability, market reach, and overall performance.
  • Territory Management: Traveling regularly throughout the assigned territory to nurture existing customer relationships, cultivate new partnerships, and explore untapped business opportunities.
  • Sales Strategy & Market Development: Leading the development and execution of the sales strategy for Omnikey Desktop and Embedded readers in all areas with an emphasis in key verticals such as Healthcare, Enterprise, Banking, Secure Printing, and EV Charging.
  • Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy: Defining and executing the GTM strategy for Omnikey readers in the LAM region. Working with marketing and product management teams to ensure that messaging, positioning, and sales tools align with the region’s unique market demands.
  • Business Development: Identifying and pursuing new business opportunities within target verticals. Creating comprehensive account plans to drive new revenue and expand existing accounts.
  • Customer Engagement: Engaging with end-users, resellers, and system integrators to promote the benefits and applications of Omnikey Desktop and Embedded solutions. Ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction through tailored solutions and ongoing support.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Working with marketing, technical, and product management teams to ensure alignment between market needs and product offerings. Providing feedback to guide product roadmaps and enhance solution offerings.
  • Industry Engagement: Representing HID Global and the Omnikey product line at industry events, conferences, and meetings to enhance market visibility and establish HID as a leader in the region.
  • Performance Reporting: Delivering detailed performance metrics and regular reports on sales progress, channel performance, and GTM effectiveness.

Your Experience and Background include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or technology preferred.
  • A minimum of 5 years of demonstrable experience in business development and/or technical sales, preferably within the technology or RFID sector, with a proven track record of sales and a solid understanding of RFID technologies and the sales process.
  • The ideal candidate has 5+ years of channel sales experience in Latin America, a strong network of partners and distributors, and a proven track record in driving revenue growth. They must excel in negotiations, sales strategy, and partner management, understand regional market trends, and be fluent in Spanish and/or Portuguese with English proficiency.
  • Previous experience in Physical or Logical access control use cases, with familiarity in Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Authentication credential technologies, as well as additional knowledge in mobile-centric digital transformation, is highly advantageous.
  • Proven ability to develop and manage a network of channel partners and integrators.
  • Experience in developing and executing strategic initiatives resulting in sales growth, particularly within the finance, healthcare, retail/point of sale, enterprise, or secure printing verticals. Understanding of end-user corporate cultures and decision-making processes in Banking, Education, and Commercial Real Estate is beneficial.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to lead presentations and establish credibility with both customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work as part of a cross-functional team. Experience working effectively across various departments, such as marketing, product development, and technical teams, to drive results.
  • Strong reasoning abilities to investigate and analyze information, draw relevant conclusions, and deal with complexity and ambiguity.

What we can offer you:

  • Competitive salary and rewards package
  • Competitive benefits and annual leave offering, allowing for work-life balance
  • A vibrant, welcoming & inclusive culture
  • Extensive career development opportunities and resources to maximize your potential
  • To be a part of a global organization that is pioneering the hardware, software and services that allow people to confidently navigate the physical and digital worlds

Why apply?

  • Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
  • Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part-time job seekers.
  • Integrity: You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted.

HID is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce that reflects the global communities we serve. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Our goal is to create a workplace that empowers everyone to thrive and be their authentic selves, fostering an environment of mutual respect and inclusivity. If you have a disability and require assistance or accommodation to participate in the application process or to perform essential job functions, please contact .

We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!
On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.
When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

Assa Abloy AB is a Swedish conglomerate whose offerings cover products and services ranging from locks, doors, gates and entrance automation. This also includes controlling identities with keys, cards, tags, mobile and bio-metric identity verification systems. Assa Abloy was formed in 1994, when Assa AB was separated from Swedish security firm Securitas AB.

  6. Atenção às tendências: O copywriter deve estar sempre atento às tendências do mercado, ao comportamento do consumidor e às inovações na área de marketing.

title: Account Manager Sao Paulo
description:
Who are we?

Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences, and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your stepping stone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges, and achieve all your projects with success.

At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and provide proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:

  1. Brief Call : Our process begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to learn about you, understand your motivations, and ensure we have the right job for you.
  2. Interviews : Typically around 3 interviews, depending on the role's seniority. You will meet with your potential line manager and other team members to discuss your experience, skills, the role, and our culture and opportunities.
  3. Case Study : Depending on the position, you may be asked to complete a test, such as a role play, technical assessment, or problem-solving scenario.

We adapt our process to each individual and role, always aiming to provide the best candidate experience. We look forward to meeting you!

Job description

The Account Manager plays a crucial role in ensuring the satisfaction and retention of both clients and independent professionals employed through Amaris Consulting .

Here are the main responsibilities:

  • Client Support and Relationship Management: Act as the primary contact for clients and independents, providing support and resolving issues.
  • Onboarding and Guidance: Facilitate onboarding for new clients and employees, ensuring understanding of services and benefits; support employees with administrative, legal, and financial matters.
  • Contract and Compliance Management: Oversee contract preparation and management, ensuring legal and regulatory compliance.
  • Dispute Resolution: Resolve conflicts promptly, and implement measures to prevent future disputes.
  • Quality Assurance and Improvement: Monitor service quality, gather feedback, and implement improvements.
  • Communication and Reporting: Keep stakeholders informed and prepare reports on account status and challenges.
  • Professional Development Support: Support employees' professional growth through resources, training, and knowledge sharing.
  • Market Awareness: Stay updated on industry trends and laws to advise and plan strategically.

**Ideal candidate:**

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
  • 1-3 years of customer service or similar experience.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal skills, attention to detail, and organization.
  • Fluent in Portuguese, Spanish, and English.
  • Proficient in MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Independent work ability, problem-solving, analytics, and reporting skills.
  • Mastery of generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT) is a plus.

Amaris Consulting is proud to promote diversity and inclusivity and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates.

Diferenciais

  1. Experiência prévia em transformação cultural e desenvolvimento de equipes em ambientes dinâmicos.

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.

Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page .

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As an implementations specialist, you will become an equity expert and use that knowledge to implement our clients onto the Carta software, setting them up for long-term success. You will work to:

  • Establish strong customer relationships and inspire long-term loyalty by providing a high quality and timely on-boarding process as the first service provider post-sale

  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on-boarding process
  • Work closely with product, engineering and our internal implementations leaders to improve the experience for our customers
The Team You’ll Work With

Carta is looking for an Implementation Specialist to join our Rio SMB/MM Team as part of our larger Delivery team. Our Delivery team members have grown to become some of the strongest contributors in our company due to their thorough understanding of our software, customers, and the business value we deliver. Ideal candidates will have a strong passion for financial services, building customer relationships, project delivery, and analytical problem solving.

title: Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems
description:
Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems

Join to apply for the Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include top public cloud and silicon providers, along with industry leaders across sectors. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. We operate with a distributed team of over 1200 colleagues across more than 75 countries, with few office-based roles. Teams meet in person 2-4 times a year in various global locations.

We are hiring a Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems for Canonical's Devices business. This role involves coordinating and completing large, complex customer-facing projects, overseeing all aspects of delivery, and acting as the main liaison between engineering teams and customers.

The projects involve delivering Ubuntu images on devices ranging from robots, edge gateways, and IoT devices to PCs and automotive systems. This is a high-profile position requiring building and maintaining relationships with team members, customers, partners/vendors (Silicon vendors, OEMs, ODMs, IHVs), and other departments.

Location: Remote in the Americas region.

Responsibilities include:

  • Managing projects through their lifecycle to meet goals for Canonical and clients
  • Delivering engineering professional services
  • Collaborating with engineering teams on custom board enablement and Ubuntu image delivery
  • Developing project statements of work
  • Creating and maintaining project schedules
  • Securing client agreement on schedules and work items
  • Ensuring projects are within scope, time, and resources
  • Managing risk mitigation plans
  • Addressing technical issues to achieve delivery outcomes
  • Communicating regularly with clients and stakeholders
  • Managing delivery of third-party deliverables
  • Updating management on project status
  • Identifying additional engineering requests outside existing contracts
  • Promoting Canonical technologies to customers
  • Supporting work across different time zones and non-traditional hours

Candidate profile:

  • Experience managing engineering services projects, software development teams, and field engineers
  • Experience managing cross-cultural, multi-continent projects (Asia, Europe, Americas)
  • Degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math preferred
  • Knowledge of Linux, open source community, and computer architecture
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Strong leadership and problem-solving skills, with partnership-building experience
  • PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 certification preferred
  • Ability to work non-standard hours and travel up to four times annually

Benefits include:

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints
  • Annual learning and development budget of USD 2,000
  • Performance reviews and bonuses
  • Comprehensive benefits including leave, parental leave, wellness programs, travel opportunities, and more

About Canonical:

Canonical is a pioneer in open source software, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We recruit globally and uphold high standards of excellence. Our remote work model has been in place since 2004, encouraging innovative thinking, continuous learning, and skill development.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing fair consideration to all applicants regardless of background or identity.

Manhã

Estamos com oportunidade em aberto para atuar em nossa Gestão de Leitos.

Descrição de Atividades:

  • Monitorar o painel de leitos das Unidades de Internação, UTI e UCO e Reservas, e direcionar as situações pendentes aos responsáveis, a fim de mantê-lo atualizado;
  • Receber diariamente do NCIH a planilha de pacientes em isolamento para melhor planejar ocupação dos leitos no hospital;
  • Planejar e realizar a distribuição de leitos para os pacientes conforme o Mapa Cirúrgico do dia seguinte;
  • Receber as solicitações, planejar e realizar a distribuição de leitos conforme as solicitações de internação via P.S, Recepção e pedidos de transferências internas, e informar o leito ao setor solicitante;
  • Receber as solicitações e reservar antecipadamente os leitos conforme demanda recebida;
  • Direcionar a re-organização dos pacientes nos setores de internação juntamente com o Enfermeiro do setor, a fim de obter os quartos conforme a necessidade de acomodação dos pacientes na espera pelo leito (apartamento ou enfermaria);
  • Efetivar as movimentações de transferências no sistema MV;
  • Acompanhar as altas médicas e hospitalares, direcionando as equipes de Hotelaria e Higienização para a liberação dos leitos conforme a prioridade para internação;
  • Manter a Recepção de Internação informada quanto à previsão de leitos vagos e a posição dos leitos em arrumação;
  • Manter contato com a Hotelaria e Higienização para liberação dos quartos;
  • Acompanhar a ocupação do leito pelo paciente e/ou acompanhante, seja na internação (via Recepção) ou transferência entre setores (P.S, UTI, UCO, Unidades), gerenciando o tempo de reserva do leito;
  • Monitorar o tempo de desocupação do leito pelo paciente e acionar as equipes responsáveis em cada situação identificada;
  • Contatar os pacientes/acompanhantes em Alta Médica (via telefone), a fim de agilizar a saída hospitalar conforme os prazos determinados;
  • Conversar com os acompanhantes e pacientes sobre troca de acomodação e etapas de liberação do leito, tanto na Recepção quanto nas Unidades de Internação;
  • Manter contato com o Centro-Cirúrgico e Recepção para priorizar a distribuição dos leitos ao longo do dia, conforme aquele que tiver mais urgência na ocupação do leito;
  • Manter contato com o Pronto-Socorro para identificar internações pendentes, atrasadas ou novas internações (busca ativa);
  • Monitorar o tempo de internação dos pacientes via Pronto-Socorro;
  • Acompanhar os processos de interdição e liberação de leitos para Manutenção (preventiva e corretiva) junto à Hotelaria;
  • Solicitar materiais administrativos ao estoque conforme rotina vigente;
  • Realizar contato com familiares dos pacientes de alta da UTI;
  • Apoiar a supervisão e gerência em atividades administrativas relacionadas ao fluxo do paciente;
  • Solicitar agendamentos ambulatoriais SUS para pacientes regulados quando necessário;
  • Realizar levantamento de dados relacionados ao fluxo do paciente quando solicitado pela supervisão ou gerência;

Nossos horários que atuam nos centros logísticos, trabalham 100% presencialmente. Assim garantimos a qualidade da nossa logística e também fortalecemos nossa cultura de colaboração e agilidade.

Qual será a sua missão

O(a) profissional será responsável por padronizar processos, impulsionar melhorias, desenvolver e realizar treinamentos, monitorar KPIs para propor soluções e garantir suporte na implementação de novos processos. Terá também participação ativa na resolução ágil de problemas e será referência técnica operacional, de acordo com os objetivos da área.   • Domínio de processo: Ser referência técnica no processo operacional, sendo facilitador e dando suporte a dúvidas e problemas sistêmicos.

Requirements

O que você precisa para assumir o desafio:

  • Pacote Office completo (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) - excel intermediário à avançado;

About Atacadão

O Atacadão é a única rede atacadista alimentar presente em todos os estados do Brasil, com 415 pontos de operação, sendo 379 lojas de autosserviço e 36 atacados de entrega e centros de distribuição, que juntos alcançam 95% dos 5.570 municípios do país.
Somos um dos maiores empregadores do país, com 76 mil colaboradores e colaboradoras que trabalham diariamente pela missão de oferecer alimentos de qualidade a preços justos para o abastecimento de comerciantes, transformadores e consumidores finais.
Com infraestrutura moderna e eficiente, o Atacadão disponibiliza aos seus clientes uma variada gama de produtos, com cerca de 10 mil itens, nas categorias de laticínios, hortifrúti, bebidas, doces e biscoitos, higiene pessoal, limpeza, bazar, produtos da linha pet, automotivo, entre outros, além de serviços como padaria, açougue e frios e fatiados.
O Atacadão marca presença no ambiente digital por meio do seu e-commerce, com um próprio canal de vendas online mais direcionado a transformadores, comerciantes e empreendedores de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas, pela possibilidade de adquirir volumes maiores de itens, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega que atendem ao consumidor final, e também o Meu Atacadão, aplicativo que permite que os clientes encontrem ofertas diferenciadas enquanto fazem suas compras nas lojas físicas.
Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta & biodiversidade.

O Grupo Carrefour Brasil promove e incentiva a inclusão e a diversidade! Por isso, estimulamos a candidatura de mulheres, profissionais negros (as), LGBTI+ e de pessoas com deficiência.

Nosso maior desafio é promover e liderar a transformação do modelo de operação e manutenção de redes de Telecom, aportando tecnologia, revisando procedimentos, otimizando recursos e, principalmente, investindo na capacitação e no desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores. Sua missão será:

Executar serviços de instalação (fibra óptica), bem como realizar serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva de cabos aéreos e subterrâneos, mantendo-os em boas condições de funcionamento, obedecendo ao procedimento padrão de qualidade e dos prazos previstos.

Se interessou? Venha trabalhar em uma empresa que conecta pessoas!

  • Visitar clientes para execução de serviços de instalação, reparos e manutenção de linhas telefônicas de assinantes e Velox;

  • Realizar contatos com o cliente em casos de reincidências de defeitos;
  • Acionar o DG em casos de ausência de sinal da linha telefônica, de ausência de sinal Velox ou se deslocar até o mesmo para verificação de jumper no caso de estações não atendidas;
  • Realizar teste final para concluir o trabalho de manutenção;
  • Efetuar o encerramento da ordem de serviço com o CL, URA ou PDA;
  • Detectar anomalias na rede telefônica identificando os casos de armários com defeito, postes quebrados, cabos partidos, corroídos ou furtados;
  • Realizar levantamento e mapeamento das áreas ofensoras;
  • Fazer configuração básica no microcomputador do cliente, caso seja necessária a criação de discador, habilitando a placa de rede e fixando o DNS na mesma;
  • Identificar a melhor localização para fixação de antena, solicitando autorização ao cliente ou administrador antes da realização do serviço;
  • Estudar alternativas para encaminhamento e fixação do cabo coaxial até o local designado pelo cliente;
  • Validar níveis de sinais disponíveis na rede interna para atendimento do ponto adicional, sem comprometer os pontos já instalados;
  • Não é necessária experiência na área (a empresa fornecerá todo treinamento).

Benefícios:

  • Assistência de saúde (extensivo à dependentes);
  • Assistência odontológica (extensivo à dependentes);
  • Ticket refeição ou alimentação;
  • Seguro de vida;

Processo de seleção:

  • Step 3: Avaliação RH
  • Step 5: Análise de documentação

Fomos reunidos por nossas capacidades. Juntos, aprendemos e nos aperfeiçoamos. Nos tornamos um time unido e coeso, que vem construindo um jeito próprio de realizar. Acreditamos na meritocracia, valorizamos o crescimento pessoal e o aprimoramento profissional. Somos guiados por resultados, e especialistas em servir com excelência e segurança. Porque temos consciência de nossa responsabilidade em impactar positivamente a vida de nossos clientes. Por isso, nos desafiamos e nos mobilizamos para fazer mais e melhor a cada dia. Para nos superar. Para construir o futuro que queremos. E, ao longo dessa jornada, deixar a nossa marca.

Temos orgulho de ser Serede!

  • Promover a melhoria contínua no setor de manutenção buscando melhorar a confiabilidade e disponibilidade dos equipamentos de Automação;

Aqui na Farmácia Artesanal a diversidade faz parte da nossa essência!

Venha fazer parte do Time Artesanal!

Somos o maior Grupo de Farmácia Magistral da América Latina, estamos presentes em mais de 10 estados com mais de 125 lojas. Até 2026 chegaremos com 200 lojas e tudo isto só será possível através de um time altamente engajado e preparado. Já somos mais de 1000 colaboradores e agora queremos ter você fazendo parte deste time de feras.

A Farmácia Artesanal valoriza a diversidade em todas as suas formas e acredita no valor inerente de cada ser humano. Acreditamos que a força e a sustentabilidade da nossa empresa estão intrinsecamente ligadas à multiplicidade de perspectivas e experiências de nossa equipe.

Com esse compromisso em mente, queremos enfatizar que todas as oportunidades oferecidas pela Farmácia Artesanal estão abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD). Estamos comprometidos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acessível, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar e alcançar seu potencial máximo. Ao diversificar nossa equipe, podemos oferecer melhores soluções para nossos clientes e contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa e inclusiva.

Buscamos talentos que compartilhem dos valores com base no respeito, inovação, desenvolvimento, melhoria contínua e bons relacionamentos.

Se você tem paixão por aprender e colocar em prática o que aprende, trabalha de forma colaborativa, é inovador e gosta de compartilhar ideias e opiniões, esta pode ser a sua oportunidade de crescer e trabalhar em uma empresa que valoriza tudo isso.

Se identifica com esses valores? Está em busca de uma oportunidade de carreira? Se candidate em uma de nossas oportunidades e venha fazer parte da equipe da Farmácia Artesanal!

COMO SERÁ SEU DIA A DIA:

  • Atuar como responsável técnico respeitando conhecendo e praticando a legislação vigente;
  • Apoiar a equipe quanto às devidas práticas farmacêuticas durante a operação;
  • Atendimento ao cliente;
  • Participar de atividades e/ou reuniões do planejamento estratégico e/ou tático;
  • Monitorar e atualizar a ferramenta contendo os indicadores da loja e calendário promocional;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das metas;
  • Realizar a gestão de pessoas da equipe responsável;
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos padrões de apresentação da equipe e organização da loja;
  • Realizar reuniões semanais com a equipe para traçar objetivos, projeções, campanhas, mudanças de procedimentos e regras produtos;
  • Realizar avaliações de desempenho e feedbacks com o foco no desenvolvimento do capital humano;
  • Implementar e/ou executar as ações de marketing no pdv envolvendo merchandising, layout, eventos e promoções;
  • Monitorar e tomar ações para o controle de perdas (balanço, diferença de caixa, requisições, etc);
  • Acompanhar e monitorar as rotinas do caixa;
  • Acompanhar o mercado sugerindo ações e/ou apresentar oportunidades de novos produtos e serviços;
  • Realizar pedidos semanais de revenda e materiais de consumo;
  • Cancelar os medicamentos pendentes após prazo estipulado e encaminhar para reaproveitamento.

O QUE BUSCAMOS EM VOCÊ:

  • Ensino superior completo em Farmácia com CRF ativo;
  • Experiência no Varejo Farmacêutico;
  • Experiência em gestão de equipes;
  • Desejável experiência na área magistral;
  • Capacidade de liderar, motivar e desenvolver pessoas;
  • Raciocínio crítico e analítico.

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS:

  • Remuneração: piso salarial;
  • Horário de trabalho: 44hs semanais - Segunda a Sábado;
  • Local de trabalho: disponibilidade para atuar nas lojas de Belo Horizonte e região metropolitana.

O Boticário está em busca de um Auxiliar de Loja que seja organizado, atencioso, tenha visão de dono, queira crescer profissionalmente e goste de trabalhar com pessoas para integrar nosso time de colaboradores. Junte-se ao nosso time de FERAS!

Atribuições:

  1. Realizar o recebimento de mercadorias por meio da conferência e registro pelo sistema dos produtos, embalagens e lacres;
  2. Assegurar a organização e qualidade do estoque, cumprindo os padrões estabelecidos, facilitando a localização e reposição rápida de produtos;
  3. Controlar o prazo de validade das mercadorias, seguindo a metodologia PEPS, monitorando as datas e evitando desperdícios;
  4. Abastecer a loja regularmente, mantendo uma apresentação atraente dos produtos;
  5. Zelar pelos produtos, evitando danos e garantindo a satisfação do cliente;
  6. Participar da organização e limpeza da loja para manter os ambientes adequados;
  7. Participar de treinamentos pertinentes à função através das plataformas de ensino.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Disponibilidade de Horário;
  • Experiência com estoque em lojas do varejo será um diferencial.

Além disso, buscamos profissionais com:

  • Proatividade;
  • Agilidade;
  • Disponibilidade para convênios de faculdade e com o Sesc.

Sobre a Empresa:

Somos uma das maiores empresas gestoras de franquias do Brasil, reunindo marcas como Hering, Levi’s, O Boticário, Quem Disse, Berenice? e EUDORA. Com mais de 42 anos de atuação, estamos presentes em Rio de Janeiro e Minas Gerais, com uma equipe apaixonada de mais de 651 colaboradores.

Nossos Valores e Visão:

Valorizamos visão, atitude, paixão, excelência, respeito e inovação. Nosso objetivo é ser o maior grupo de multifranquias reconhecido nacionalmente por shoppings, marcas e colaboradores. Temos como missão revolucionar o mercado de multifranquias com inovação, tecnologia e gestão de pessoas, proporcionando experiências únicas aos clientes e crescimento contínuo.

Descrição

AEROMOT é uma empresa líder em tecnologia aeronáutica, especializada na comercialização de aeronaves, peças e componentes, prestação de serviços de manutenção aeronáutica e soluções para missões especiais.

Ao longo de cinco décadas, nossa trajetória tem sido marcada por progresso, desenvolvimento tecnológico, qualidade e inovação, consolidando-nos como uma das mais importantes empresas da aviação brasileira.

O que você vai encontrar trabalhando aqui

Em nosso ambiente de trabalho, proporcionamos uma experiência dinâmica, estimulando constantemente o aprendizado e o desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores. Somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos e o espírito de colaboração e união fazem parte do nosso dia a dia.

Nossa cultura organizacional baseia-se nos princípios da psicologia positiva, buscando o equilíbrio entre a qualidade de vida, o bem-estar e a felicidade de nossos profissionais, associando-os à produtividade e rentabilidade para o negócio.

Diversidade

Comprometidos com a diversidade e a inclusão social, valorizamos cada indivíduo, reconhecendo que as diferenças também contribuem para nosso crescimento. A Aeromot se empenha em criar um ambiente de trabalho seguro, livre de preconceitos e discriminação, com oportunidades abertas a todas as pessoas.

Nossa empresa é caracterizada por ser acolhedora e inclusiva, fundamentada na cultura do respeito, proporcionando um espaço livre e de bem-estar, mantendo os profissionais engajados e focados em um propósito comum.

Se você é uma pessoa apaixonada pelo que faz, está em busca de grandes desafios e tem interesse na aviação, junte-se a nós, vem ser Aeromot!

Atividades:

  • Compreender necessidades legais, regulatórias e das partes interessadas no Sistema de Gestão Socioambiental;
  • Desenvolver e implementar políticas para minimizar impactos ambientais na manutenção de aeronaves;
  • Criar e manter sistemas conforme normas como ISO 14001 e RBAC 145;
  • Manter documentos e registros organizados e atualizados;
  • Investigar e corrigir não conformidades identificadas em auditorias e inspeções;
  • Garantir cumprimento de leis ambientais e acompanhar mudanças regulatórias;
  • Avaliar continuamente desempenho ambiental, consumo de recursos e geração de resíduos;
  • Desenvolver planos para reduzir e destinar corretamente resíduos da manutenção aeronáutica;
  • Capacitar profissionais sobre práticas sustentáveis e proteção ambiental;
  • Identificar riscos ambientais e desenvolver planos de contingência;
  • Implementar iniciativas para aprimorar o desempenho ambiental da empresa;
  • Manter diálogo com órgãos reguladores, comunidades e grupos ambientais;
  • Realizar auditorias para avaliar conformidade e propor melhorias;
  • Preparar a empresa para auditorias externas e certificações;
  • Trabalhar com outras equipes para integrar sistemas de gestão;
  • Apoiar em demais atividades do setor.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior em Biologia, Engenharia Ambiental, Gestão Ambiental ou cursos correlatos (cursando ou completo);
  • Conhecimento de Normas NBR ISO 14001 (Meio Ambiente), RBAC 145 (Organização de Manutenção de Produto Aeronáutico), entre outros e requisitos legais e específicos do sistema de gestão integrada;
  • Qualificações específicas em Gestão Ambiental e Meio Ambiente;
  • Pacote Office e Inglês técnico;
  • Experiência em auditoria de sistemas de gestão;
  • Conhecimento da Legislação da Aviação da ANAC (incluindo leis, regulamentos, instruções suplementares) e Sistemas de Gestão, documentação e registros Aeronáuticos serão considerados diferenciais;

title: Operador(a) de Logística
description:
O que esperamos de você:

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Experiência em recebimento, conferência, separação e movimentação de mercadorias.
  • Experiência no sistema SAP será considerado um diferencial.
  • Desejável habilidade na administração de prioridades.
  • Capacidade de aprendizado, prática e permanente respeito aos procedimentos, normas e regras da empresa.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar aos finais de semana e feriados.
  • Orientação para a satisfação do cliente.

Como é o dia a dia de um(a) Operador(a) de Logística:

  • RECEPÇÃO DE MERCADORIAS:
    • Realiza a recepção quantitativa e qualitativa das mercadorias comercializadas e não comercializadas (equipamentos, materiais de escritório, etc), verificando e identificando o estado geral, fornecedor, metragem, referência, tonalidade, prazo de validade, etc.
    • Prepara o espaço físico e equipamentos necessários para a correta recepção, evitando a perda de produtividade na conferência.
    • Anota sobre o relatório de conferência tudo o que for relativo às mercadorias recebidas (quantidades, estado aparente, validades, etc), assegurando qualidade e prevenindo perdas.
    • Armazena as mercadorias no endereço de depósito correto, através da leitura da ficha da recepção buscando agilizar as futuras montagens dos pedidos de retira ou de entrega.
    • Etiqueta os produtos com código de barra ausente ou defeituoso e inserir as etiquetas de segurança nos produtos sensíveis a furtos, assegurando que as mercadorias entregues ao comércio estejam disponíveis para venda.
    • Separa as mercadorias seguindo a tipologia dos fluxos quanto a mercadorias de loja ou do depósito.
    • Libera as mercadorias para a armazenagem na Loja ou no Depósito, contatando a equipe de Reposição ou a de Armazenamento para efetuar a armazenagem (Cautela).
    • Realiza ações anti-demarcas através da checagem qualitativa e quantitativa rigorosa sobre as mercadorias recepcionadas, através de um bom fluxo de veículos no pátio da Recepção de Mercadorias e do correto manuseio dos equipamentos de movimentação (paleteiras, "gaiolas", etc).
    • Mantém organizado os equipamentos, ferramentas de trabalho e EPI’s (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual).
    • Realiza o empilhamento seguro dos paletes evitando prejuízos à bens e pessoas.
    • Mantém a área de recepção limpa e organizada ajudando a combater a demarca e prevenindo acidentes no trabalho.
    • Recebe as demarcas validadas pelo Comércio realizando a conferência qualitativa e quantitativa e colocando o produto demarcado no local de despejo.
    • Recebe as devoluções aos fornecedores, validadas pelo Comércio, realizando as conferências quali-quantitativas e agendando a coleta.
    • Recebe as remessas para Assistência Técnica, realizando a conferência qualitativa e quantitativa e agendando a coleta.
  • RETIRADA E ENTREGA EM DOMICÍLIO:
    • Efetua a separação do RSS (reserva sobre estoque), identificando os produtos e informando a separação para o setor comercial.
    • Realiza o endereçamento das mercadorias fazendo a reserva física de espaço e inventário rotativo com base na listagem dos produtos de RSS.
    • Efetua a entrega das mercadorias ao cliente, de forma ágil e cordial, colocando-as no veículo do cliente.
    • Separa e confere as mercadorias verificando todos os itens descritos no pedido emitido, disponibilizando-as para entrega a clientes no setor de retirada de mercadorias ou para transportadora (entrega em domicilio).
  • REPOSIÇÃO:
    • Repõe os produtos na loja de forma adequada.
  • GESTÃO DO ESTOQUE:
    • Armazena e garante a qualidade e a confiabilidade dos estoques.
    • Verifica diariamente os pedidos gerados pela área comercial, analisa a consistência de dados necessários no pedido (endereços, telefones, data entrega, referência, disponibilidade, etc), organizando a separação cronológica dos pedidos e liberando-os para faturamento.
    • Efetua atendimento telefônico informando os clientes sobre prazos de entrega.
    • Informa o Supervisor de Logística sobre eventuais problemas que envolvem a equipe de separação, operação e produtos.
    • Auxilia o Supervisor de Logística para o bom andamento dos endereçamentos do depósito (set-up, inventários rotativos, etc).
    • Efetua o tratamento diário dos pedidos cancelados de RSS.
    • Efetua o registro referente a demarcas de mercadorias apontadas na separação de mercadorias.
    • Tem bom relacionamento e atua como elo de contato com a transportadora terceirizada.
    • Juntamente com a equipe de SAC realiza o trabalho preventivo de possíveis problemas com mercadorias.
    • Informa ao Supervisor de Logística e/ou ao Gerente de Logística sobre eventuais ocorrências de problemas com mercadorias.
    • É referência no atendimento do Balcão de Retirada de Mercadorias.
    • É responsável pelos seus equipamentos de trabalho.
    • Respeita as normas de segurança.

Candidate-se para esta vaga efaça parte da nossa construção!

Desejamos boa sorte no seu processo!

Não deixe de visitar uma loja e conhecer ainda mais sobre como é fazer parte do nosso time, vendo de perto as pessoas que entregam as melhores experiências para nossos clientes.

Incentivamos a diversidade e a inclusão, por isso, todas as vagas estão disponíveis para Pessoas com Deficiências (PcD).

title: Strategic Customer Development Manager
description:
Who is USP?

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
Brief Job Overview

We are seeking a dynamic Strategic Customer Development (SCD) Manager, based in Brazil, to drive customer engagement and business development for Biologics and Microbiology across key LATAM markets: Brazil (50%), Mexico (30%), Argentina (20%), and Colombia (10%). This leadership role is ideal for a professional passionate about innovation in the life sciences sector and skilled in cultivating high-impact relationships.
As a core member of the LATAM team, the SCD Manager will take ownership of customer and stakeholder engagement, overseeing a portfolio of approximately 30 strategic accounts in the Biologics segment. This includes identifying and expanding opportunities with both established and emerging biopharmaceutical companies, reinforcing USP’s presence and value proposition in the region. Working in close partnership with the Marketing Director, LATAM Senior Director, and cross-functional teams such as Regional Program Operations (Bios PUT), the incumbent will co-develop and execute account plans aligned with global initiatives, driving measurable outcomes that contribute to LATAM’s strategic goals.
Collaboration will be key, this role will actively interface with Scientific Affairs and External Affairs to align on customer needs, market trends, and advocacy opportunities, amplifying USP’s impact through targeted promotion of its products and services.
This is a unique opportunity for a people-centric leader with a regional mindset and a passion for advancing public health through strategic partnerships and innovation in Biologics.
How will YOU create impact here at USP?

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
The Strategic Customer Development Manager has the following responsibilities:
• This position highly impact USP mission and current Global strategies/key resolution, by visiting and supporting Biologics customers, and by identifying new key people and decision-makers in Biologics market in LATAM, promoting USP’s products and services to support the improvement of quality of medicines.
• This person will impact USP sustainability by developing and implementing engagement strategies to grow USP RS Bios sales and to expand relationships with its target-audience. Likewise, they will create high-valued relationships to increase USP’s account penetration and the overall value of USP within each account and stakeholders.
• Works closely with Biologics Global team by understanding Bios strategies and activities to be adequately implemented in LATAM market. Also, they will actively participate as a champion in Bios Global regional team to represent LATAM.
• Works with LATAM Marketing & LATAM Sr. Director, other LATAM team members in analyzing data, preparing reports on Biologics revenue trends for USP and competitor products, and make recommendations on business impact and directions.
• Develop an overall understanding of USP’s business in its targeted market (Bios). Understands the macro and micro factors that influence USP’s overall business to factors relevant to specific users (of USP products and/or services) within manufacturer organizations.
• Work in collaboration and supporting GEA team to provide training/Bios workshops to Regulators and stakeholders.
• Acquires knowledge on how the customers use USP products and identify areas for potential new business.
• Analyzes sales data for domestic and regional accounts and identifies trends and patterns that can assist the RPO staff in developing strategic plans for future revenue growth.
• Participates in User Forums, face-to-face and/or virtual customer visits and USP trade shows to educate customers and to promote USP reference standards, publications, and education products.
Who is USP Looking For?

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
• Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy, biotechnology, or chemistry.
• Sales and account management experience in the Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical and/or Biopharma Lab Services industries.
• Strong account and project management skills required.
• Flexibility to travel to other countries, such as Mexico, Argentina and Colombia.
• Excellent interpersonal and communications skills.
• Self-motivated and proactive with sense of urgency, ability to prioritize and focus on key objectives and able to work in a fast-paced multi-task environment.
• Proven aptitude for building relationships, credibility, and trust with customers, and creating a collaborative work environment.
• Ability to influence without direct authority.
• Solution-oriented and innovative; can identify creative options for resolving issues that respond to multiple customer interests and needs.
• Native Portuguese; Proficiency in Spanish and English.
Additional Desired Preferences

• Excellent knowledge and understanding of pharma industries with established contacts within the research, lab management and product development departments.
• Scientific background and understanding coupled with successful sales track record are strongly preferred.
• Experience in an analytical laboratory desired.
• Experience delivering oral presentations to groups of people desired.
• Proven ability to convert prospects into customers and build long term relationships.
Supervisory Responsibilities
None, this is an individual contributor role.
Benefits
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

title: Senior Tester
description:
Quality Assurance

What We Do

The Quality Assurance team owns the testing process, risk management, and quality evaluation of all products and functions across Epic. Our team works closely with developers and production to ensure the best possible user experience for our community and customers.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a full-time Tester for our new testing group in Brazil. The person in this role will be responsible for running tests and reporting bugs within a major Epic product. You will work closely with the development team and will actively contribute to the smooth execution of tasks, assisting with technical challenges and promoting professional growth within the team. The Senior Tester will play a supporting role in overseeing test teams and providing guidance and career development support to team members. If you are interested in a fast-paced environment, capable of navigating interpersonal quandaries, and desire to work on a world-class QA team, then we would love to talk to you.

In this role, you will

  • Execute and develop detailed test cases to ensure the quality of multiple products.
  • Create/Maintain/Own comprehensive test cases based on predefined test scenarios.
  • Investigate and analyze issues thoroughly to identify root causes, and communicate or escalate issues when necessary, keeping the broader context in mind.
  • Provide the development team with reports on blocking issues, test results, and overall quality status while facilitating discussions around potential risk areas.
  • Write clear and concise bug reports with detailed reproduction steps.
  • Leverage knowledge of product features to identify issues and inefficiencies.
  • Independently set your daily priorities while also assisting with the team's priorities.

What we're looking for

  • A minimum of 2 years of experience in QA/Testing at games or software.
  • Technical software or troubleshooting skills (degree in Computer Science or equivalent, self-taught, or relevant experience).
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.
  • Experience with gaming consoles and/or mobile devices.
  • Experience with software development and building games or software.
  • Familiarity with the software development life cycle and the role of testing within it.
  • Proficient in logging defects in bug-tracking systems like Jira.
  • Experience testing software within a structured QA team.
  • Ability to analyze defect trends, identify coverage gaps, and provide feedback to prevent future issues.
  • Experience with game engines such as Unreal, Unity, etc.
  • Experience in creating and executing creative test scenarios independently, utilizing product knowledge and available feature documentation.

Nice to Have:

  • Scripting or programming skills in languages such as Python or C++.
  • CTFL Certification.

  • Habilidade analítica para acuracidade de dados e informações;
  • Domínio nas ferramentas da Qualidade e melhoria contínua;

Com sede em Minneapolis, Minnesota, EUA, a companhia chegou ao Brasil em 1997, quando iniciou as vendas do sorvete premium Häagen-Dazs. Em 2012, adquiriu o Grupo Yoki Alimentos, conquistando um novo modelo de negócios e tornando-se proprietária das marcas Yoki, Kitano e Mais Vita, reconhecidas pelos brasileiros há décadas. Join to apply for the Auxiliar de Limpeza role at Clínica IEM - Odontologia Avançada

O Auxiliar de Limpeza em uma clínica odontológica é responsável por manter os ambientes clínicos e administrativos limpos, organizados e seguros, garantindo um ambiente de trabalho saudável tanto para os pacientes quanto para a equipe. Este profissional realiza tarefas de limpeza e manutenção, seguindo procedimentos específicos para atender às normas de higiene e segurança exigidas em ambientes odontológicos.

  • Limpeza Geral:
Varrição e Aspiração: Realizar a varrição e aspiração de pisos nas áreas clínicas e administrativas da clínica odontológica, incluindo salas de atendimento, corredores e áreas comuns.
Mopagem e Lavagem: Mopper e lavar pisos com produtos e equipamentos apropriados, utilizando técnicas adequadas para garantir a higienização completa dos ambientes.
Limpeza de Superfícies: Limpar e desinfetar superfícies como mesas, bancadas, janelas, vidros e maçanetas, focando especialmente em áreas de contato frequente e de atendimento ao paciente.
  • Manutenção de Áreas Sanitárias:
Limpeza de Banheiros: Limpar e desinfetar banheiros e lavabos, garantindo a limpeza de vasos sanitários, pias, espelhos e pisos, e realizar a reposição de papel higiênico e sabonete.
Controle de Estoque: Monitorar e gerenciar o estoque de produtos de limpeza e materiais de higiene, realizando pedidos de reposição quando necessário para garantir a disponibilidade contínua dos itens essenciais.
  • Cuidados com Áreas Clínicas:
Higienização de Equipamentos: Auxiliar na limpeza e desinfecção das áreas onde são realizados procedimentos odontológicos, garantindo a conformidade com os padrões de higiene exigidos pela clínica.
Preparação de Ambientes: Garantir que as salas de atendimento estejam prontas para uso, com todas as superfícies desinfetadas e os materiais organizados.
  • Organização e Manutenção de Ambientes:
Organização de Espaços: Manter a organização dos ambientes, assegurando que os itens estejam em seus devidos lugares e que as áreas de trabalho e atendimento estejam sempre limpas e arrumadas.
Descarte de Lixo: Coletar e descartar o lixo de forma adequada, seguindo os procedimentos estabelecidos para a separação e eliminação de resíduos.
  • Cuidados com Equipamentos e Produtos:
Manutenção de Equipamentos: Utilizar e manter os equipamentos de limpeza em boas condições, realizando a limpeza e conservação dos mesmos após o uso.
Uso de Produtos: Manusear produtos de limpeza de forma segura e eficiente, seguindo as instruções dos fabricantes e as normas de segurança específicas para ambientes clínicos, evitando desperdícios.
Economia de Recursos: Garantir o uso adequado e econômico dos produtos de limpeza e equipamentos, minimizando o desperdício e maximizando a eficiência.
  • Segurança e Conformidade:
Uso de EPIs: Utilizar Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) adequados, como luvas, máscaras e óculos de proteção, conforme necessário para garantir a própria segurança e a conformidade com as normas de segurança e higiene.
Segurança no Trabalho: Seguir todas as normas de segurança e procedimentos estabelecidos para a limpeza, incluindo a correta utilização e armazenamento de produtos e equipamentos de limpeza.
Conformidade com Normas: Assegurar que a limpeza e a desinfecção sejam realizadas em conformidade com as normas e regulamentos de higiene e segurança da clínica odontológica.
  • Relato de Problemas e Necessidades:
Identificação de Problemas: Identificar e relatar quaisquer problemas de manutenção ou necessidades de reparo aos supervisores ou à equipe responsável.
Acompanhamento de Solicitações: Acompanhar e verificar a resolução de solicitações e problemas relatados para garantir que as áreas da clínica estejam devidamente mantidas.

title: Always looking for great teachers
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Even when we don’t have an open position, we are always keen to get to know talented and committed teachers who are interested in working with us.

Sending your cover letter and CV through this on-going post doesn’t exclude the need for constantly looking at our website and applying to specific vacancies. However, we will always take a look at this database when we open a position.

Check below to understand what we look for in our teachers. If you feel you have the skills and the cultural fit to work at St Paul’s, we would love to receive your application.

In your cover letter, please indicate which area you would be more interested in (Pre-Prep, Prep, or, for Senior School (11+) subject specialism).

About us:

St. Paul’s was founded in 1926 and was the first school in South America to receive accreditation from the UK government as a British School Oversees. Fully coeducational, with about 1,000 pupils, aged from 3 to 18, it is a school with history and tradition, but which embraces innovation, contemporary values and the latest in digital learning. We are a world-class school, and an international member of HMC and IAPS, and a member of COBIS and the LAHC. We are proud of our local, national and international reputation and we constantly strive to improve the opportunities for our pupils and staff. Our recent BSO inspection judged us as a leading British School overseas, and you can download the report from our website. Our exceptional facilities place teaching and learning at the heart of the school.

Watch a video of the school:

More details about the school can be found at

What is our Teacher’s main Role?

Our teachers promote excellence in teaching and learning for the children at St Paul’s by encouraging curiosity, independence and engagement through developing a safe, happy, supportive and stimulating environment, ensuring playful, exploratory and language-rich experiences so that children of all ages are challenged to reach their full potential.

Overall Responsibilities

  • Plan broad and balanced learning experiences, creating and selecting appropriate resources in order to support pupils' progress and develop children’s sense of curiosity and wonder about the world;
  • Identify and monitor individual abilities, interests and needs, promoting differentiation in order to support every child’s full development;
  • Ensure pupil progress by making use of formative and summative assessment to inform planning so that pupils are successful in their learning;
  • Ensure a safe and effective learning environment is maintained by using the school’s behavior policy consistently in order to set clear and high expectations of pupil behaviour;
  • Promote positive relationships through modeling and collaborating across the school community to ensure a respectful, safe and secure environment;
  • Support children’s language development and communication skills by modelling consistent and proficient use of English in order to provide effective immersion into the language;
  • Support children’s exploratory experiences and independence both indoors and outdoors by planning activities and enriching the provision in order to develop a stimulating learning environment;
  • Care for pupils’ social, emotional and physical well-being, by creating a safe and positive culture within the classroom in order to make children secure to learn, take risks and make mistakes;
  • Report any safeguarding issues that arise following the school safeguarding policy in order for each child to feel safe in the school environment;
  • Collaborate and contribute towards the school vision by participating in whole-staff meetings, year group planning sessions, supporting colleagues and sharing resources and best practice with the aim of participating actively and working well within a team.
  • Manage class assistants effectively by establishing a strong partnership and coaching them when necessary in order to have a positive impact on pupil progress using the school’s review process;
  • Communicate effectively with parents by establishing a positive partnership, reporting on individual pupil’s progress, well-being and other relevant issues in order to ensure all parts involved are informed and working towards the same goals.

Our benefits

  • Health insurance
  • Dental plan
  • Pension plan
  • Onsite lunches
  • Food card
  • Transportation tickets

Safeguarding

The school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and expects all staff and volunteers to share in this commitment. The offer of the role would be made subject to receipt of satisfactory references, proof of relevant qualifications, identification checks and other safeguarding checks (including Internet and Social Media profiles and exposure), an overseas check if appropriate and a pre-placement medical assessment. Proof of entitlement to work in Brazil is also required where necessary.

Equality, Diversity and Inclusion

St Paul’s is committed to equality, diversity and inclusion. We recognise the value of diverse environments and strive to promote a culture in which all pupils, staff and members of the school community are welcomed and supported to fulfil their potential, regardless of their background or personal characteristics. We oppose all forms of unlawful and unfair treatment, embarrassment, discrimination, bullying and harassment.

Minimum Requirements

  • To have a relevant university degree qualification
  • To have a certified teaching qualification, e.g. either a PGCE from the UK or Pedagogia or Licenciatura from a Brazilian university
  • To have knowledge of Office 365
  • To have knowledge and experience of the appropriate national curricula for your age range (English and Brazilian)
  • To have good communication skills
  • To form positive professional relationships (with staff, parents, pupils)
  • To be pro-active, flexible, resilient and collaborative
  • To be a team worker
  • To have a love of working with children; to genuinely care about their welfare and progress as individuals
  • To be committed to professional development

title: Executive Director, Content Distribution
description:
Executive Director, Content Distribution

Join to apply for the Executive Director, Content Distribution role at Lehigh University .

This position is within the Communications & Public Affairs (UCPA) department and involves leading content distribution efforts across digital and print platforms. Responsibilities include overseeing a team, collaborating on content strategies, and integrating communication tools and platforms to enhance university-wide engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and mentor a team of web developers, strategists, and systems thinkers.
  • Collaborate with content creation teams to align content distribution with audience needs.
  • Coordinate cross-campus communication strategies, reduce redundancy, and promote innovation.
  • Implement and oversee content distribution strategies aligned with university goals.
  • Develop a unified, data-driven communication ecosystem by integrating various digital tools and platforms.
  • Assess and optimize system architecture for efficiency and strategic alignment.

Key Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Communications, Web Development, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of eight years of related experience in marketing, communication, or web development.
  • Knowledge of web hosting, SaaS platforms, open source systems (Drupal), and content syndication.
  • Experience with web development, production workflows, and DevOps.
  • Proficiency in Google Analytics and Data Studio.
  • Experience managing budgets and service contracts.
  • Background in digital campaigns, audience segmentation, and social media platforms.
  • Ability to work across a large organization, fostering community and aligning departmental goals.
  • Strong management skills and a culture of transparency.

Lehigh University offers a competitive salary, benefits, and opportunities for professional growth. The role may allow partial remote work, and the expected start date is on or after July 1, 2025. Successful applicants will undergo background checks as required.

If you are a visionary digital leader passionate about storytelling and content distribution, apply to help shape Lehigh’s communication strategy and digital presence.

Ready to redefine air travel? The journey starts here, with you at SITA.

As a Business Development Manager you will be responsible for promoting SITA’s for Aircraft services. The position is based in Brazil to support the South and Central America region. You will work on Business Development, Relationship Management and providing sales solutions.
What You Will Do

  • Drive commercial growth of SITA airlines solutions by identifying and developing key prospects within the assigned territory. This is a commercial role, but preference will be given to technical background, while commercial support will be provided by existing business development managers in the team.

At SITA, we disrupt the status quo, by empowering our people to pioneer innovations that touch the lives of billions.
